description.value: Best Falafel is a Syrian-Lebanese restaurant on Commercial Drive, a popular Vancouver cycling corridor, founded by Damascus-born owner Hisham Wattar who has run the location since 2000. The menu spans falafel, shawarma, donair wraps, plates, and salads with vegetarian and gluten-free choices, and the restaurant has grown to three Metro Vancouver locations. It has served over a million customers and is considered a local fixture on the Drive.
